document.abstract: The following recommends changes to be made to ST 382:2007 as a result from the incorporation of the “Channel IDs” and “Mono Source Track IDs” properties to Amendment 1 to SMPTE ST 377-1:2011. Note that citations to “337M” are intentional to refer to SMPTE 337M-2000 to remain consistent with the remainder of SMPTE 382.
